$comment: Single source of truth for the AACA Attendance Dataverse schema. Applied by provisioning/Deploy-Schema.ps1. Choice values use the publisher option prefix 58210 (582100000+). Never renumber an existing choice value; append new ones.

tables.description: A school campus. Maps to a business unit of the same name.
App user profile. App Role drives the UI only; data access comes from security roles.

columns.description: Shows the Billing app to this person. Data access comes from the AACA Finance security role.

tables.description: A student. Owned by the student's current teacher. Never deleted; archived instead.

primaryName.description: Last, First. Set by the app on save.

columns.description: Server-assigned number used to build the Student Key (campus code at intake + '-' + this). Seed set above the highest existing key (1128 on 2026-10-01).
Student Key (e.g. CW-1083). Required, unique, read-only after creation; used by the SharePoint Student Directory and parent absence form.
Regional Center Only students receive services outside school (RC- keys); they have no enrollment or attendance. Blank = School.

tables.description: A billable or tracked service: Special Education (SAI) attendance, day services (aide, BII, transportation, HNS) and CodeMetro clinical services. QuickBooks item and billing unit are maintained by finance.

columns.description: School Day = billed in days from attendance; Clinical = billed from CodeMetro minutes.
Unit the QuickBooks item bills in. Clinical minutes are converted to decimal hours for Hours items.
No = shown on the RDS but never invoiced (e.g. no-show codes).

tables.description: A school year including its summer program (e.g. Aug 2026 - Jul 2027).
Quarter or summer program date range. Blank campus = applies to all campuses.
A non-school weekday or a make-up school day. Blank campus = all campuses.
One continuous assignment of a student to a teacher/campus/ratio. Closed and replaced on change; never deleted. Owned by the teacher.

columns.description: Blank = open-ended within the school year.

tables.description: Maintainable list of absence reasons. Required when an absence is Excused.
One row per student, service and date. Snapshot columns preserve history. Owned by the recording teacher. Soft-deleted only.

columns.description: Blank = Not classified. Only meaningful when Present = No.
SharePoint Student Absence Log item ID of the parent report whose approval created or classified this absence.

tables.description: Month-end lock per campus. Month = first day of the month.
Key/value configuration.
Business action with reason, for the in-app audit viewer. Built-in Dataverse auditing is the tamper-proof record. Who/when = Created By/On.
One row per parent absence report (SharePoint Student Absence Log item) that office staff approved or dismissed. Its presence means the report is done.
Family portal: links a parent or guardian (Contact) to one student. Only linked, active guardians see the student in the portal. Owned by the student's campus team.
Family portal: an absence reported by a linked guardian. Submitted on = Created On (server time, used for the 24-hour notice rule). A flow sets the campus and makes the campus team the owner.

columns.description: Same as First Day Absent for a single day.

tables.description: Who pays: a school district, regional center or private payer, with its QuickBooks customer.
A Funding Source name as CodeMetro writes it (normalised: trimmed, single spaces, upper case), mapped to a Funder.
A CPT Code or Service Name as CodeMetro writes it (normalised, upper case), mapped to a Service.
The funder that pays a student's school days (SAI) for a date range.
One RDS grid row a student is entitled to, from the CodeMetro student services export (a 2:1 aide = two rows).

columns.description: Finance override: ignore this row for the RDS and billing.
Identity of the CodeMetro row (student|code|funder|start|end|occurrence) used to update on re-import.

tables.description: One CodeMetro services-rendered file. It replaces all delivered services dated within its date range (open months only). Rows In = rows on grids (sessions) + exceptions.
Delivered minutes for one student + funder + service + day, summed from CodeMetro session rows.
A CodeMetro row that could not be placed on a grid, with the reason. Nothing is dropped silently.

lookups.description: Blank until the person has an account. One Staff row per user (checked by Grant-AacaAccess and the integrity check).
Deleting the contact removes its links.
The guardian who reported the absence (kept as billing evidence).
Set by the campus-assignment flow from the student's active enrollment.
